conclusion: NO true hardware INT8 CUDA execution. The 'sim' representation dequantises int8 weights to fp32 and computes in fp32; the 'cpu_dynamic' representation uses a CPU-only torch.ao backend. Any GPU timing of Q8 is therefore SIMULATED Q8 (fp32 arithmetic on quantised-then-dequantised weights) and must not be presented as INT8 GPU acceleration.
